Thanks for the ping. I reviewed Nimbus' requests and our standard insurance schedule. High-level: most of this is within the range we accept but there are three items to confirm/clarify before we commit:

1) Umbrella / Excess: we can typically provide $10M excess; need to confirm with finance on cost impact. If broker requires, we will obtain.

2) Additional Insured & Primary/Non-Contributory: we should accept Additional Insured for liability related to our services. However, blanket GI AI endorsements can be broad; propose limiting to liabilities arising out of Redwood's performance under the Order Form and include the standard Redwood endorsement language. For Primary & Non-Contributory, we should accept for CGL only (not E&O/cyber) — customer is asking broadly. Recommend we propose: 'Primary and non-contributory with respect to commercial general liability only.'

3) Cyber liability specifics: the requested $5M is reasonable for this account size but must ensure policy covers regulatory fines/penalties. Our broker may need to confirm. If the customer demands explicit coverage for regulatory fines, we may need carve-outs depending on jurisdiction.

Operational asks: we can provide a COI and the AI endorsement as certificates/endorsement forms from our carrier. However the COI alone does not bind coverage — customers sometimes ask for insurer to issue an endorsement naming them as AI and attaching the endorsement to the COI. That is acceptable if our insurer agrees.

Next steps (recommended):
- Karthik: ask Nimbus to allow 'AI for liability arising from Redwood's performance under the Order Form' and to limit P&NC to CGL only.
- Neha: touch base with our broker (Ari at Certainty Brokers) to confirm ability to issue COI + endorsement and timeline + any premium impact for Umbrella/E&O/Cyber changes.
- Legal will redline Section 8 to add a cross-reference to the Insurance Schedule and clarifying language above.

I can draft the proposed email to Nimbus if helpful.

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference
